name: everything-claude-code
description: Claude Code toolkit - agents, commands, skills, rules, and hooks for productive AI-assisted development
one_liner: A free, all-in-one bundle of add-ons for Claude Code (specialized helper agents, shortcuts, and rules) built from one team's ten months of real product-building experience.
buyer: A startup CTO who wants their team's Claude Code setup to follow best practices (testing, security review, documentation) immediately, without spending weeks building that configuration themselves.
business_use_cases: A startup installs it as their default Claude Code configuration so every engineer gets the same testing, security-review, and documentation standards automatically.
A solo developer uses the 'token optimization' and 'memory persistence' guides to cut their own AI tool costs on long projects.

money_ideas.idea: Sell paid consulting/setup services that adapt this toolkit to a specific company's stack and conventions.
Turn the linked 'guides' (token optimization, verification loops) into a paid course, using the free repo as the lead magnet.

steal_this: Package the two linked guides into a concise paid PDF/video course ('Claude Code for Production Teams') and use the free plugin as the funnel that drives people to buy it.
